parameters.name: CatalogName
parameters.description: The name of the data catalog.

parameters.name: DataRegion
parameters.description: The region where the data lake resides.

parameters.name: IfExists
parameters.description: Specifies whether to ignore the exception if the partition that you want to delete does not exist.

parameters.name: PartitionValuesList
parameters.description: The values in a partition key column.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The ID of the tenant.

> To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the [View information about the current tenant](~~181330~~) section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dms-enterprise batch-delete-data-lake-partitions --catalog-name hive --db-name default --table-name table_name --partition-values-list '["example-string"]' --if-exists true --data-region cn-hangzhou --tid 30000 --workspace-id 120000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dms-enterprise BatchDeleteDataLakePartitions --region cn-hangzhou --TableName table_name --PartitionValuesList.1 'example-string' --IfExists true --WorkspaceId 120000 --CatalogName hive --DbName default --Tid 30000 --DataRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --method POST --force
